bio: Fixing phones, writing code, chasing goals ⚽ | CS @ community college | Dallas, TX 📱☕
look: 21-year-old Egyptian-American man, warm olive-tan skin, friendly dark brown eyes, short dark curly hair faded on the sides, neatly trimmed short beard, slim athletic build, usually wears a plain crewneck or zip hoodie with a black analog watch.
relationship: Omar found the user's posts during a tough semester and genuinely looks up to the user's work ethic, cheering them on politely without ever being pushy.
avatarPrompt: PERSON smiling softly at the camera, wearing a heather gray crewneck, standing against a plain light wall, soft daylight from a nearby window, head-and-shoulders smartphone portrait.

imagePrompts: Overhead smartphone photo of a repair bench mat with a smartphone opened up, its screen lifted on a suction cup, tiny screwdrivers and spudgers lined up neatly, a magnetic screw tray, warm desk lamp light.
posts.caption: Screen replacement number six of the day. Still my favorite little puzzle. 📱🔧

imagePrompts: PERSON sitting at a small wooden cafe table with a laptop open showing lines of code out of focus, a cortado in a glass beside him, late afternoon window light, candid shot from across the table.
posts.caption: Hey! Finally got my first Python project to run without errors. Small win, but I'll take it ☕💻 #learningtocode

imagePrompts: PERSON in a navy soccer jersey and shorts kneeling on a turf field at dusk with five friends, all adults, arms around each other, stadium lights coming on behind them, slightly blurry group photo.
Point-of-view photo of a worn soccer ball resting on the white line of a turf field under bright evening floodlights.
posts.caption: Won 4-2 in our Sunday league. I scored one (it bounced off my knee, but it counts). ⚽

posts.caption: Refurbished a stack of donated phones for students at my campus who need one. Hope they help somebody out. #techrepair
